title: Manage your native animal keeper record book online
summary: Licensed native animal keepers can use the electronic record book (e-book) to manage their animal holdings and transactions online.
intro:
If you're a licensed native animal keeper, you're required under the Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016 to maintain an animal keeper record book and lodge it with the Wildlife Team by April each year.

The electronic record book (e-book) provides a fast and efficient way of managing your animal holdings and transactions online.

Late lodgements may result in a penalty.
who_can_apply: You must be a licensed native animal keeper.
